# Syllabus

## Intended learners

Learners beginning a reproducible technical workflow. This example assumes
basic arithmetic and no programming knowledge.

## Observable outcomes

By the end of the example session, learners can identify a source fixture,
calculate a result, and explain how to update the record after changing inputs.

## Session plan

| Activity | Minutes | Evidence of learning |
|---|---:|---|
| Discuss source versus result | 5 | Correctly identify each |
| Follow the worked example | 10 | Reproduce the stated mean |
| Complete the exercise | 10 | Submit calculation and short record |
| Compare and reflect | 5 | Explain what changed and why |

## Assessment

Use the practice rubric to give feedback. This starter defines no institutional
grades, credits or certification. Add those only when the relevant requirements
are known. Provide an accessible alternative to any software-dependent activity.
